shared_elements: schematic figures scattered across a natural rock surface
profile figures rendered as simple outlines/lines
justification: Both surfaces carry small, highly schematic figural motifs scattered without frames or ground lines across an irregular natural rock face, and in both the figures are reduced to simple outlines or line-bodies rather than modelled forms. However, the depicted subjects differ: A shows a row of tiny stick anthropomorphs, an isolated small human and an elongated boat-like form, whereas B shows chunky quadrupedal animals in profile with rounded bodies, so beyond generic schematic rock-figures there is no shared specific motif or relationship.
